    Setting the Standard

    The American Society of Mechanical Engineers

    A Season for Giving Back

    Make a lasting impact by guiding the next generation of engineers.

    Become a Mentor

    Engineering Through Times of Change

    As technology reshapes industries, ASME continues to provide the knowledge, standards, and community engineers need to thrive.

    Read More

    ASME's FY2026 Annual Report

    Learn how ASME is ensuring engineers are equipped to adapt to change and to lead it.

    Learn More

    ASME Live in New Orleans | December 6-11, 2026

    Learn from experts, connect with peers, and see engineering in action on a site tour.

    Learn More

    Engineer the Future of Policy

    Bring your engineering perspective to a fellowship opportunity.

    Apply Today

    GDTP-2018 Certification Exams Now Open

    Earn a credential aligned with current GD&T standards

    Apply Now

    1880 Year Established

    72,000+ ASME Members

    130+ Countries With ASME Members

    10,000+ Individuals Trained Annually

    Standards

    ASME is the globally-recognized, trusted source of standards used around the world.

    More Standards
    Model Organization Practices
    Ropes
    Thermoplastic Piping Systems
    B5.40 Spindle Noses and Tool Shanks for...
    B94.33.1 Jig Bushings (Metric)
    Y32.7 Graphic Symbols for Railroad Maps...

    Courses

    ASME Learning & Development is recognized as a leader in training for engineers.

    Explore Courses

    Publications

    ASME publishes innovative engineering research in journals, eBooks, and conference proceedings.

    Explore Publications

    Certifications

    An ASME certification signifies that you or your company is committed to public safety and quality.

    Locate ASME Certified Companies
    Use the ASME Certificate Holder Search to find certified companies.
    How to Start a Certificate Application
    Learn about how to prepare for and start an ASME accreditation or certification.
    Personnel Certification
    ASME offers GDTP and QRO personnel certifications.
    More Certifications

    ME Magazine

    Building on more than a century of delivering engineering news and expert perspectives, ME now offers open access to all content.

    About ME All Content
    Voice AI App Helps Rural Silk Artisans

    How an Indian social enterprise worked with an Engineering for Change Fellow to make a marketplace app accessible to rural women artisans.

    Technology and Society
    Reshoring Is Coming. Are Mechanical Engineers Ready?
    Business and Career Support
    How M2X Energy Turns Waste Methane Into Fuel
    Energy
    5 Propulsion Breakthroughs That Got America Moving

    About ASME Business and Career Support Conferences and Events Engineering Membership Standards Development ASME Information Publications

    Events

    Share ideas, learn, network, and engage with colleagues from your industry at an ASME event.

    All Events

    ASME CATALYZE 2027
    Apr 20–21, 2027 Detroit, MI The Department at Hudson’s Detroit

    May 17–20, 2027 Nashville, Tennessee

    Becoming an ASME Member

    Joining ASME is the most important connection a current or future Mechanical Engineer can make.

    Purchase Membership Renew Membership
    Learn More

    Save up to 50% on courses, books, journals, conferences, and more

    Mechanical Engineering® - your digital destination on ASME.org

    Use of Access Engineering online reference tool

    Student or professional memberships available

    Purchase Membership Renew Membership
    Learn More

    Sections and Divisions

    Members can engage with various ASME official groups (Sections & Technical Division). Official groups are led by ASME volunteers.

    Learn more

    Professional

    Sections are ASME local chapters. Each ASME member is assigned to a local section based on their geographic location.

    Student

    Student Sections represent ASME at University/College campuses globally.

    Technical

    Technical Divisions are groups formed around specified technical interests
